as="targetPoint"/></mxGeometry></mxCell><mxCell id="c30" style="endArrow=none;dashed=1;html=1;strokeColor=#bbbbbb;" edge="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"><mxPoint x="3080" y="110" as="sourcePoint"/><mxPoint x="3080" y="1550" as="targetPoint"/></mxGeometry></mxCell><mxCell id="c31" value='<b>1. Intake</b><br>gh pr list first, then npm run status -- --ready (a ticket says ready until something merges). Compare HEAD with origin/main; check-farm-freshness.mjs on the shared checkout.<br><font color="#666666" style="font-size:9px">cheap: a few commands, no agent</font>' style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=6;spacingRight=4;verticalAlign=top;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;" vertex="1" parent="c15"><mxGeometry x="60" y="15" width="260" height="110" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c32" value="<b>Chooses the batch</b> (AskUserQuestion with the seam map; never picked by the orchestrator)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=6;spacingRight=4;verticalAlign=top;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;" vertex="1" parent="c14"><mxGeometry x="360" y="25" width="260" height="70" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c33" value='<b>2. Seam map</b><br>Reads every candidate ticket in full + git log on its paths → collision matrix, serialisation needs, wrong ratings, ordering constraints. ~40 lines back.<br><font color="#666666" style="font-size:9px">≈1 min · ≈$0.17 (tools-e9, 9 tickets)</font>' style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=6;spacingRight=4;verticalAlign=top;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;" vertex="1" parent="c16"><mxGeometry x="360" y="12" width="260" height="85" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c34" value="<b>Put the batch to the user</b><br>Every ticket carries a difficulty; orchestrator never rates one." style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=6;spacingRight=4;verticalAlign=top;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;" vertex="1" parent="c15"><mxGeometry x="360" y="15" width="260" height="70" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c35" value="<b>3. Dispatch one builder per ticket</b><br>mkdir scratch/&lt;id&gt;/{build,gate-1,gate-2,land} · branch name free (local + ls-remote) · agent type from the pairing table, never a model param · ticket, base, branch, scratch dir, owner answer if needs-decision · no ship authority." style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=6;spacingRight=4;verticalAlign=top;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;" vertex="1" parent="c15"><mxGeometry x="660" y="15" width="260" height="120" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c36" value='<b>Set up</b><br>git fetch · read common.md + builder.md from origin/main · worktree-farm.sh (≈0.5 s) + npm run build (minutes) · checkout --no-track -b &lt;branch&gt; origin/&lt;base&gt;<br><font color="#666666" style="font-size:9px">fixed cost paid by every agent, in its own worktree</font>' style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=6;spacingRight=4;verticalAlign=top;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;" vertex="1" parent="c17"><mxGeometry x="660" y="8" width="260" height="88" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c37" value="<b>Build the ticket</b><br>Implement the Build section · dated Log entry with command + output · oxlint, npm run check · git merge origin/main if moved · <b>preflight.mjs</b> (merge-tree probe vs every open PR, check, the tool's suites) · push · <b>gh pr create --draft</b> · report<br><font color="#666666" style="font-size:9px">preflight 10–12 min on a downloader branch · builders: mean 28 min active / 109 min wall (n=96)</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=6;spacingRight=4;verticalAlign=top;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;" vertex="1" parent="c17"><mxGeometry x="660" y="102" width="260" height="124" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c38" value='<b>CI on the draft PR</b> runs while the gate works: check, Linux + Windows matrix, container build, CodeQL<br><font color="#666666" style="font-size:9px">≈10–17 min; Windows leg informational</font>' style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=6;spacingRight=4;verticalAlign=top;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;" vertex="1" parent="c20"><mxGeometry x="660" y="20" width="260" height="80" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c39" value="<b>4. Check the build report</b> before spending a gate: a test named per Done when line · every command with its output · what it could not verify · open decisions · head sha confirmed by git ls-remote · draft PR number." style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=6;spacingRight=4;verticalAlign=top;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;" vertex="1" parent="c15"><mxGeometry x="960" y="15" width="260" height="110" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c40" value="Accepted?" style="rhombus;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;strokeWidth=2;" vertex="1" parent="c15"><mxGeometry x="1030" y="135" width="120" height="70" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c41" value="<b>5. Dispatch the gate</b> — <i>nothing from the build</i>: ticket id + path, base sha, head sha, PR number, scratch dir, what to attack, which positive control to plant, depth (narrow for mechanical). Never ship authority." style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=6;spacingRight=4;verticalAlign=top;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;" vertex="1" parent="c15"><mxGeometry x="1260" y="15" width="260" height="100" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c42" value='<b>Set up</b><br>git fetch · read common.md + reviewer.md + gate.md from origin/main · checkout --detach &lt;head&gt; · farm + npm run build<br><font color="#666666" style="font-size:9px">same fixed cost again</font>' style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=6;spacingRight=4;verticalAlign=top;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;" vertex="1" parent="c18"><mxGeometry x="1260" y="10" width="260" height="75" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c43" value='<b>Gate 1 (gate.md steps 1–7)</b><br>brief as of base → diff → run the thing on one real input, check by a 2nd method → plant a positive control → hunt defects at depth → trace every Done when line to spec file + test name (runs the suites: downloader project ≈9 min; new timing assertion ×10) → invariants → 4 NFRs → verdict by the severity table<br><font color="#666666" style="font-size:9px">single gate: mean 14 min active / 26 min wall (n=23) · $1–4</font>' style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=6;spacingRight=4;verticalAlign=top;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;" vertex="1" parent="c18"><mxGeometry x="1260" y="92" width="260" height="150" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c44" value="<b>Return</b> gate-1@&lt;sha&gt;.md (section) + .full.md (report). Commits nothing." style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=6;spacingRight=4;verticalAlign=top;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;" vertex="1" parent="c18"><mxGeometry x="1260" y="250" width="260" height="40" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c45" value="<b>6a. Check the two files agree</b> (git diff --no-index section vs full report's head); a difference goes back to the gate.<br><b>Open decision?</b> → to the owner <i>before anything moves</i> (AskUserQuestion, batched to a checkpoint)." style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=6;spacingRight=4;verticalAlign=top;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;" vertex="1" parent="c15"><mxGeometry x="1560" y="15" width="260" height="100" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c46" value="<b>Answers open decisions</b>; chooses fix-at-landing for below-floor findings; rewords an unmeetable Done when line" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=6;spacingRight=4;verticalAlign=top;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;" vertex="1" parent="c14"><mxGeometry x="1560" y="20" width="260" height="80" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c47" value="<b>Severity floor</b><br>any high, or a med a Done when line depends on?" style="rhombus;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;strokeWidth=2;" vertex="1" parent="c15"><mxGeometry x="1590" y="125" width="200" height="100" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c48" value='<b>No round.</b> Lows and free meds stay recorded as the gate wrote them; owner may have the lander apply a fully-stated fix with no re-gate ("Fixed at landing").' style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=6;spacingRight=4;verticalAlign=top;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;" vertex="1" parent="c15"><mxGeometry x="1560" y="245" width="260" height="70" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c49" value="<b>Who fixes?</b><br>any finding needs judgement (how, not only whether)?" style="rhombus;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;strokeWidth=2;" vertex="1" parent="c15"><mxGeometry x="1890" y="10" width="200" height="100" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c50" value="<b>Relay the whole round in one message, pasted never retyped</b>, with the owner's answers and their provenance; end the last relay with <i>conditional ship authority</i>. Confirm delivery with ListAgents + the artefact." style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=6;spacingRight=4;verticalAlign=top;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;" vertex="1" parent="c15"><mxGeometry x="1860" y="125" width="260" height="95" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c51" value='<b>Builder resumed (SendMessage)</b><br>ff-only to origin/branch · merge main if moved · reproduce each finding (fail before, pass after) or <b>refute</b> it with command + output · narrow checks → preflight again (10–12 min) → push → report per finding<br><font color="#666666" style="font-size:9px">a resume re-reads the whole transcript every turn</font>' style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=6;spacingRight=4;verticalAlign=top;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;" vertex="1" parent="c17"><mxGeometry x="1860" y="20" width="260" height="120" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c52" value='<b>Fresh fixer</b> (all findings mechanical)<br>checkout --detach origin/branch · farm + build · reproduce · fix only what was named · preflight (10 min) · push · report<br><font color="#666666" style="font-size:9px">fixers: mean 5 min active / 22 min wall (n=86) · $0.2–1.5</font>' style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=6;spacingRight=4;verticalAlign=top;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;" vertex="1" parent="c19"><mxGeometry x="1860" y="20" width="260" height="110" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c53" value="<b>7. Accept the report or send it back</b> — five checks, not a re-review: what was run · spec + test per Done when · open decisions · population vs the one that exists · builder's and gate's accounts agree (a disagreement is a finding, relayed with both verdicts)." style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=6;spacingRight=4;verticalAlign=top;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;" vertex="1" parent="c15"><mxGeometry x="2160" y="15" width="260" height="110" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c54" value='<b>8. Wake the same gate once</b> (SendMessage): the sha it gated, the new head, its own findings as written, each refutation as command + output. Never a fresh reviewer for round 2.<br><font color="#666666" style="font-size:9px">a wake costs a fraction of a fresh gate</font>' style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=6;spacingRight=4;verticalAlign=top;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;" vertex="1" parent="c15"><mxGeometry x="2160" y="130" width="260" height="95" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c55" value='<b>Gate 2 — scoped to the round</b><br>checkout new head · git log --first-parent --no-merges &lt;gated&gt;..&lt;new&gt; · a verdict per earlier finding: fixed / in part / not fixed / refuted · new findings only in the lines the round touched · rebuild only if a dist consumer moved · one new ### Gate 2 file + full report · says plainly whether anything is a high<br><font color="#666666" style="font-size:9px">two-gate agents: mean 27 min active / 93 min wall (n=66): ≈70% of the wall clock is waiting for the round</font>' style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=6;spacingRight=4;verticalAlign=top;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;" vertex="1" parent="c18"><mxGeometry x="2160" y="10" width="260" height="150" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c56" value='<b>Gate 3</b> only when gate 2 itself raised a high: narrow, scoped to that fix, no owner answer needed. Another high → stop, put the state to the user.<br><font color="#666666" style="font-size:9px">13 of 119 recent gate agents ran 3 gates; 47 of 253 sections past gate 2 found 0 highs (adr/006)</font>' style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=6;spacingRight=4;verticalAlign=top;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;" vertex="1" parent="c18"><mxGeometry x="2160" y="170" width="260" height="85" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c57" value="Gate 2 raised a <b>high</b>?" style="rhombus;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;strokeWidth=2;" vertex="1" parent="c15"><mxGeometry x="2510" y="10" width="160" height="80" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c58" value="<b>9. Ship authority to whoever holds the last round</b> (resumed builder, else a fresh fixer) with both gate file paths; read a CI-conditional verdict <i>before</i> the landing push (it cancels the gated sha's run)." style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=6;spacingRight=4;verticalAlign=top;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;" vertex="1" parent="c15"><mxGeometry x="2460" y="115" width="260" height="100" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c59" value="<b>Land</b><br>commit the ticket's awaiting: line if any gate row says awaiting · <b>review-record.mjs --land</b>: validate splices in a scratch clone → one commit per gate section, status done in the first → push → verify → <b>preflight again</b> (≈10 min) · post each .full.md on the PR thread · name every model in the body · gh pr ready (unless held as draft for merge order)<br><font color="#666666" style="font-size:9px">landing: the third preflight of the ticket</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=6;spacingRight=4;verticalAlign=top;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;" vertex="1" parent="c19"><mxGeometry x="2460" y="15" width="260" height="160" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c60" value="<b>CI reruns on the landing head</b>; the gated sha's run is cancelled by the push" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=6;spacingRight=4;verticalAlign=top;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;" vertex="1" parent="c20"><mxGeometry x="2460" y="30" width="260" height="60" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c61" value="<b>10. relative="1" as="geometry"><Array as="points"><mxPoint x="3354" y="1260"/><mxPoint x="3354" y="170"/></Array></mxGeometry></mxCell><mxCell id="c114" value="<b>Where the time goes — measured from the accounting rows in reference/history.md (rows with an Active / wall field, late Sept → 2026-10-18)</b><br>• Gate agents (n=107): mean <b>24 min active / 94 min wall</b>. A single gate 1 alone: 14 / 26. An agent that ran gates 1–2: 27 / 93. Extremes: dl-114 15 min active / 9 h 42 wall (2 cold restarts), dl-120 2 h 04 active / 3 h 03, lg-40 1 h 07 / 1 h 48.<br>• Builders (n=96): mean <b>28 min active / 109 min wall</b>. Fixers (n=86): <b>5 min active / 22 min wall</b>. Orchestrator (floor): 25 min – 2 h 28 active over 1 – 4 h wall per batch.<br>• The gap between active and wall is <b>waiting</b>: a gate agent sits idle through the whole fix round until it is woken for gate 2, and every hand-off (build → check → gate → route → owner → round → accept → re-gate → land → checks) is a turn of one orchestrator that is also serving every other ticket in the batch — 8 to 10 serial relays per ticket.<br>• Recent gate costs: $0.9–2 for a narrow gate, $2–4 for standard gates 1–2, $5–8 for the long ones (lg-23 $7.74, lg-40 $6.45, repo-103 $7.72). Batch totals: $43 for 7 tickets (2026-10-15), $19 for 2 (2026-10-17)." style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=10;spacing=8;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="40" y="1580" width="1040" height="190" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c115" value="<b>Fixed costs every agent pays again, in its own worktree</b><br>• git fetch + reading its role pages from origin/main (common.md 179 lines + role page 105–185 lines + gate.md 280 lines for a gate).<br>• worktree-farm.sh (≈0.5 s) then <b>npm run build</b> of every workspace (minutes); without it suites fail with packageEntryFailure.<br>• The tool's test project: downloader ≈9–10 min (browser-resolver.test.ts alone sets the wall clock), repeated by the gate for its own measurements.<br>• <b>preflight.mjs ≈10–12 min</b>: run by the builder before the draft PR, again by whoever fixes the round, and again inside --land at the landing — three times per ticket on the happy path, four with a send-back.<br>• CI on GitHub ≈10–17 min per push (Linux + Windows matrix, container, CodeQL); the landing push cancels the gated sha's run so it runs twice too." style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=10;spacing=8;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="1100" y="1580" width="900" height="190" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c116" value="<b>What the gates return (verdicts named in history.md entries)</b><br>• Gate 1 (88 named): <b>23 PASS · 37 CONCERNS · 28 FAIL</b> — three in four open a round or a decision.<br>• Gate 2 (59 named): <b>32 PASS · 25 CONCERNS · 2 FAIL</b>.<br>• Over 253 committed sections (adr/006): highs 18 at gate 1, 6 at gate 2, 0 at gate 3 or later. Two gates is the default since 2026-10-03; a third only on a gate-2 high.<br>• Since 2026-10-14 the owner's usual path for below-floor findings is <i>Fixed at landing</i>: applied by the lander as the gate worded it, no re-gate (6 of 8 tickets on 2026-10-18).<br>• Models: Sonnet build → Opus gate; Opus build → Sonnet xhigh gate; Haiku build → narrow Sonnet gate, always gated. Never Haiku or Fable as a gate." style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=10;spacing=8;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="2020" y="1580" width="760" height="190" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="c117" value="<b>Legend</b> · rounded box = step, lane colour = who runs it · diamond = orchestrator decision · solid arrow = hand-off · dashed = message / CI signal · grey small text = measured cost · owner lane = AskUserQuestion checkpoints" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=10;spacing=6;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="40" y="1780" width="1400" height="30" as="geometry"/></mxCell></root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>

text.tspan: Where the time goes — measured from the accounting rows in reference/history.md (rows with an Active / wall field, late Sept → 2026-10-18)
. A single gate 1 alone: 14 / 26. An agent that ran gates 1–2: 27 / 93. Extremes: dl-114 15 min active / 9 h 42 wall (2 cold restarts), dl-120 2 h
. Orchestrator (floor): 25 min – 2 h 28 active over 1 – 4 h wall per batch.
• The gap between active and wall is
: a gate agent sits idle through the whole fix round until it is woken for gate 2, and every hand-off (build → check → gate → route → owner → round → accept →
re-gate → land → checks) is a turn of one orchestrator that is also serving every other ticket in the batch — 8 to 10 serial relays per ticket.
• Recent gate costs: $0.9–2 for a narrow gate, $2–4 for standard gates 1–2, $5–8 for the long ones (lg-23 $7.74, lg-40 $6.45, repo-103 $7.72). Batch totals: $43 for 7 tickets (2026-10-15), $19 for 2
Fixed costs every agent pays again, in its own worktree
• git fetch + reading its role pages from origin/main (common.md 179 lines + role page 105–185 lines + gate.md 280 lines for a gate).
of every workspace (minutes); without it suites fail with packageEntryFailure.
• The tool's test project: downloader ≈9–10 min (browser-resolver.test.ts alone sets the wall clock), repeated by the gate for its own measurements.
: run by the builder before the draft PR, again by whoever fixes the round, and again inside --land at the landing — three times per ticket on the
happy path, four with a send-back.
• CI on GitHub ≈10–17 min per push (Linux + Windows matrix, container, CodeQL); the landing push cancels the gated sha's run so it runs twice too.
What the gates return (verdicts named in history.md entries)
— three in four open a round or a decision.
